description: Header file defining interfaces and classes for downlink processing in a 5G/NR physical layer, including processing of PDUs, resource grid configuration, and validation.

classes.name: downlink_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing various downlink PDUs and signals within a slot.

classes.name: unique_downlink_processor
classes.description: Manages a downlink processor instance within a scope, ensuring proper release and finalization.

classes.name: downlink_processor_callback
classes.description: Callback interface extending downlink_processor, with method to finish processing PDUs.

classes.name: downlink_processor_controller
classes.description: Interface for configuring resource grid processing for a slot.

classes.name: downlink_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating downlink PDUs and configurations.

classes.name: downlink_processor_base
classes.description: Base class for downlink processor implementations.

classes.name: downlink_processor_pool
classes.description: Interface for managing a pool of downlink processors.

methods.name: process_pdsch
methods.description: Process a PDSCH PDU with associated transport blocks.

methods.name: configure_resource_grid
methods.description: Configure resource grid for a slot and return a unique downlink processor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the downlink processor or pool.

methods.name: finish_processing_pdus
methods.description: Indicate that no more PDUs will be processed and finalize processing.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Release the unique downlink processor, finalizing processing.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Access the underlying downlink processor via pointer.
